capabilities: Log activities by dragging time ranges on a 10-minute grid timeline
Display logs as color-coded category chips with tooltips
Track a to-do list and link completed tasks to timeline entries
Create or open today's daily note and write logs into its frontmatter
Export the timeline and to-do list as print-ready HTML or PDF
extras: Logs are stored in the active note's frontmatter; the sidebar shows a create-daily-note prompt when the active note is not named YYYY-MM-DD, preventing accidental logs elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual way to log how the day was spent in time slots and keep those logs inside daily notes.
summary: Time-tracking plugin that logs daily activities on a 10-minute grid timeline and saves entries to the daily note's frontmatter.
